description: Bing Search. Query Bing Search via API and retrieve structured organic results (title, link, snippet, position). Credit cost: 1 credit per call.

cc.description: Country code to search from (2-letter ISO 3166-1). Cannot be used together with mkt.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

lat.description: GPS latitude for the search origin.

lon.description: GPS longitude for the search origin.

mkt.description: Market code where results come from (e.g. en-US). Cannot be used together with cc.

num.description: Number of results per page (e.g. 10, 20, 50). This value is a suggestion. Default: 10.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1 = first page). Default: 1.

query.description: The search query you want to run on Bing.

name: bing_search
title: Bing Search
